title: Legacy UI Test Gate Retirement and React v2 Coverage Migration
goal: Retire or migrate the remaining legacy `ui/tests/` browser contracts so release readiness is based on the active React v2 operator console while preserving any still-useful acceptance-harness detectors.
scope: Testing policy, legacy `/app/` browser tests, React v2 Playwright coverage, and acceptance-harness placement.
generation_reason: A full release-readiness pass on 2026-05-10 found that `ui/tests/` still targets the retired FastAPI `/app/` UI and fails with legacy navigation/wizard expectations, while React v2 build and E2E pass.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: no active backlog task; created from release-readiness audit

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Do not revive the retired old UI. Migrate useful checks to React v2 or explicitly mark them legacy diagnostic-only.

success_criteria: Every still-relevant legacy browser assertion is either migrated to `ui-v2/tests/` or documented as obsolete with a concrete rationale.
Default Python release tests do not include retired `/app/` UI contracts.
React v2 Playwright coverage includes the active console screens and critical operator flows.
Acceptance-harness detector tests are relocated or retained in a non-legacy test lane that can run green.
Running the documented release gates is green without relying on old UI routes.

acceptance_criteria: Release-readiness commands pass using active React v2 coverage.
Legacy `/app/` test failures are no longer hidden inside the default release gate.

out_of_scope: Rebuilding or restoring the retired old UI.
Bypassing React v2 error boundaries instead of fixing render faults.
Changing runtime approvals, scope/ROE, credential handling, or kill-switch behavior.
